Pure: submitExport, buildSubmitRequest/buildAnalysisSubmitRequest (the analysis export's bound inputRevision/configuration/artifactHash), envelopeFromReceipt, downloadRouteFor. Exercised directly by __tests__/fe-s-9/receipt.test.ts.

The dark-Panel modal (catalyst Dialog + Panel variant="chart"): branding (Opal/Advisor/Co-branded, the latter two gated on an approved logo asset via brandingChoiceAvailable), the narrative toggle, account detail, optional sections. The button + modal-open state (no modal in the tree until pressed); ExportAnchorSlot finds the disabled Export control by its EXISTING data-action/data-slot name (tabs/reporting/PeriodControls.tsx, tabs/analysis/AnalysisTab.tsx -- both outside this order's grant, unedited), hides it and portals the real button into the same parent. Exercised by default.test.ts; live at both smoke captures (--click Export succeeded, rc=0 both widths).

StatusPanel (imported, unedited) driven by envelopeFromReceipt; the download link renders only when downloadRouteFor returns non-null (jobState 'ready' with an authorizedDownloadRoute). Exercised directly by receipt.test.ts.

Package-level RenderOptions added (the contract's four fields plus includeNarrative, default false) and RenderBundle.renderOptions retyped to it. assertSupported's reportKind/payload-pairing check is now gated on reportKind being PRESENT (a pre-resolution ExportBundle, which carries none, now passes through to resolveBundle instead of being refused; a bundle that DOES carry a wrong one is still refused exactly as before -- confirmed by the full, unchanged fe-s-4 manifest.test.ts refusal suite).

The inline placeholder PeriodInContext function retired; the real PeriodInContextPage (FE-s-8) now mounts, gated on narrativePacket !== null AND renderOptions.includeNarrative === true. Mutation-tested: forcing the gate to packet-presence-only made narrative-wired.test.ts's includeNarrative:false case fail as expected; reverted, byte-identical, full fe-s-9 suite re-passed 18/18.

?kind=performance|analysis and ?narrative=1 query params added; the fetch->assertSupported->resolveBundle->render pipeline replaces the old fetch->assertSupported(as RenderBundle)->render one, so a bundle implementing the FE-s-1 contract as written (report references only) now renders instead of being refused.

Mounts two ExportAnchorSlot instances (reporting selector [data-action='export'], analysis selector [data-slot='export-button']); the analysis slot finds nothing until FE-s-10 mounts AnalysisTab and renders null until then. Live at both smoke captures.
